intro: The plan as a tree on a timeline: work streams, their programs and the projects in each program. A work stream's or program's bar is the span its projects cover, and the counts beside it add up the flags raised on those projects. Open a program to see its projects. Everyone can read it.
emptyHint: Work streams, programs and projects are created on the Plan page and appear here.
barCriticalInside: holds a project on the critical path

narrow.noProjectsStream: No projects in this work stream yet.
narrow.noProjectsPicked_one: No projects in the picked program yet.
narrow.noProjectsPicked_other: No projects in the picked programs yet.
narrow.unknown: That work stream is not in the plan any more, so the overview is not narrowed to it.

announce.expandedAll: Every work stream and program expanded
announce.collapsedAll: Every work stream and program collapsed

critical.intro: The projects upstream of {{name}}, from the plan's dates; those with no slack drive its end. Projects in a folded row or outside the program pick are listed too.

proposal.covers_one: Proposes dates for the {{count}} team that works on the projects shown. Nothing changes until you accept.
proposal.covers_other: Proposes dates for the {{count}} teams that work on the projects shown. Nothing changes until you accept.
proposal.noTeams: No team has a milestone on the projects shown, so there is nothing to propose.
proposal.tooMany_one: The projects shown involve {{count}} team, and a proposal takes at most {{max}} — narrow the program or work stream pick.
proposal.tooMany_other: The projects shown involve {{count}} teams, and a proposal takes at most {{max}} — narrow the program or work stream pick.
proposal.settling: Waiting for the work stream the address names…
proposal.rightsFailed: Could not read which teams you manage; this is a preview only.
proposal.requesting: Asking for a proposal — the target windows are read-only until it arrives.
proposal.title: Schedule proposal
proposal.intro: Dashed bars on the timeline show the proposed dates, a work stream's or program's bar following its projects. Nothing changes until you accept.

saved.title: Saved proposal: {{name}}
saved.unreadable: “{{name}}” was saved in an earlier version of Astrolabe and can no longer be opened.
saved.outside_one: {{count}} of the projects this proposal moves is outside the current pick
saved.outside_other: {{count}} of the projects this proposal moves are outside the current pick
